question: What is Diginex

beats.line: Diginex is repositioning as a unified sustainability and compliance platform.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beats.action: A single halftone paper slab lowers onto open ground and settles flat as loose sheets stack on top.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex is repositioning as a unified sustainability and compliance platform.

beats.line: Its software helps organisations report ESG, climate and supply-chain data.
beats.headline: ESG DATA
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the paper slab peels open into ruled grid paper; cut documents drop into rows across it.
beats.delivery: Its software helps organisations report ESG, climate and supply-chain data.

beats.line: Four businesses were absorbed, across multiple jurisdictions.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the document stack splits into four separate paper tiles that slide together edge to edge.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Four businesses were absorbed, across multiple jurisdictions.

beats.line: The Resulticks acquisition carried a one point five billion dollar price.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as one of the four tiles swells forward and thickens into a block of stacked paper coins that fills the frame.
beats.delivery: [excited] The Resulticks acquisition carried a one point five billion dollar price.

beats.line: It adds AI-driven customer data to the compliance core.
beats.headline: AI CUSTOMER DATA
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top as the coin block flattens into a board; pins push in and string runs between paper documents.
beats.delivery: It adds AI-driven customer data to the compliance core.

beats.line: Integration execution is the primary risk here.
beats.headline: INTEGRATION RISK
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the string grid pulls loose and knots into a tangle; a rubber stamp presses beside it and holds.
beats.delivery: Integration execution is the primary risk here.

beats.line: Admin costs rose three point four million to eight point one million.
beats.headline: $8.1M G&A
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the right as the tangled string straightens into rising paper bars that lock into a chart.
beats.delivery: Admin costs rose three point four million to eight point one million.

beats.line: Shares trade at one dollar sixteen, market cap thirty-four million.
beats.headline: $1.16 / $34M
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bar chart tears downward into one long strip; a few paper coins slip off its torn end.
beats.delivery: Shares trade at one dollar sixteen, market cap thirty-four million.

beats.line: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is a growth vector.
beats.headline: $77B BRAZIL
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the torn strip unfolds into a paper map; a paper hand enters and taps one corner, holding there.
beats.delivery: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is a growth vector.

beats.line: A higher-risk, speculative position for patient investors.
beats.headline: SPECULATIVE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left as the paper map folds back down into the paper slab with its sheets restacked, and a single pin pushes through to hold it.
beats.delivery: A higher-risk, speculative position for patient investors.
